source: Owner request in Map DKC soundtrack instruments chat
verbatim: As a separate part of the DKC project, let's build a profile on the entire soundtrack and begin to map it out. The first key step is tracking down clips of all midi backings, and original tracks on youtube for listening and review. Once this is finished, we need to organize all the instruments in this, mapping them to the instruments that we have on file, while stress testing to insure that they are close. If there is a conflict between our set musicians and what the original instrument in-game is, in-game *always* wins, and we should never let this design be restrictive. Identify gaps that will need to be filled as we complete this project, place it on the master audit DKC project
scope: Original DKC1 study. Does not rewrite Roshan performer identities or commission runtime replacement.
